correctness.rationale: Exact union-find enumeration of 134 forest subsets of the explicitly specified eight-edge wheel, checked polynomial differentiation and six dihedral pair-orbit Rayleigh differences. Five have all strictly positive coefficients; the sixth has a checked exact polynomial identity giving a sum of nonnegative squares and strictly positive terms. A separately justified exact series-extension factorization and conditional covariance argument give the infinite subdivided class. 48x28 nonuniform rational tests are supplementary, not proof.

value.rationale: A natural strict multivariate weighted core case of the general arboreal-gas negative-correlation conjecture on a 3-connected non-series-parallel graph, overcoming a non-coefficientwise-positive orbit. This sharpens known unit-weight wheel results and gives a substantive infinite subdivision family, while full negative association and larger wheel cores remain open.
